Skeleton Technologies secures strategic investment led by Siemens to expand US manufacturing

Skeleton Technologies, a global leader in high-power systems for AI infrastructure, today announced a strategic investment from Siemens, bringing Skeleton’s valuation to more than $1 billion. The investment will primarily accelerate the expansion of Skeleton’s US manufacturing footprint and R&D activities in Silicon Valley to meet growing demand from hyperscalers for AI data-center power systems.

The investment deepens a long-standing relationship between Siemens and Skeleton, with the new partnership focused primarily on AI data-center infrastructure and growing demand from hyperscalers in the United States. Siemens supported Skeleton’s expansion in 2023, while Siemens Digital Industries designed and automated the company’s Leipzig SuperFactory in Germany.

Skeleton plans to invest more than $200 million in operational scale-up and R&D in Silicon Valley working directly with hyperscalers. The US expansion includes plans to establish domestic cell manufacturing, creating a fully integrated US value chain from cells to complete systems.

“Skeleton's portfolio perfectly complements Siemens' comprehensive data center offering. Our combined innovation roadmap will deliver benchmark solutions for the white space of next-generation data centers, delivered by a strong manufacturing network across Europe and the USA,” said Markus Grabmeier, President of Electrical Products at Siemens AG.

Skeleton Technologies is a developer and manufacturer of high energy and power density ultracapacitors. The company provides green and cost-effective energy storage solutions for the automotive, transportation, industrial and renewable energy markets.

Skeleton is reportedly working on increasing the manufacturing capacity for the Grossrhrsdorf production facility from half a million to about 1,000,000 supercapacitors per year in 2020. In terms of footprint, the current 3,500 square meters will be double to about 7,000 square meters by 2020.

Following the scale-up, the plan is to implement the next generation cell design, optimized for automated production and cell assembly. Further automation enables scaling up production capacity to 4,000,000 cells in the first phase, and ultimately to 10,000,000 supercapacitors to meet demand from automotive, grid, and transportation.

Skeleton Technologies is an Estonia-based ultracapacitor manufacturer founded in 2009, specializing in graphene-based supercapacitors that deliver twice the energy density and five times the power density of competitors. The company produces high-power, high-energy storage solutions for sectors including transportation, grid, industrial equipment, renewable energy, automotive, and defense.
